notes: Steadier pathing: the bot now asks the game whether it still holds a route before re sending a destination, which removes two thirds of its own move command churn. Two new optional switches, both OFF until you turn them on in the app: auto respawn in town after a death, and a dodge roll out of monster ground casts. The Live status panel now shows your gold and exp rates for the session. Looting is fully removed. Press Updates, then press Play with Helper once so the bot updates too.
